blocks.body: NeoSapien is an official one-click connector on Claude and ChatGPT. Any other AI tool that supports MCP works too — see Other AIs.

blocks.title: Here’s what it does for you
blocks.subtitle: You ask, Neo 1 recalls, your AI does the work. Things you can do:

children.title: Catch up on your day
children.subtitle: “Summarise everything I said today.”

children.title: Draft your replies
children.subtitle: “Write the follow up email on what I owe Subodh”

children.title: Prep for what’s next
children.subtitle: “Prep me for my meeting with Mohit, what did he ask last time?”

children.title: Recall any detail
children.subtitle: “What’s the medicine I discussed for my father?”

children.title: Turn talk into to-dos
children.subtitle: “Make a task list from my last daily standup”

children.title: Work across your tools
subtitle: Your AI has both Neo 1 and your other apps.

blocks.title: Quick setup
blocks.subtitle: NeoSapien is in the ChatGPT plugin directory — no URLs, no config.

items.caption: Open chatgpt.com in your laptop browser
Click on Plugins on the sidebar
Search for “NeoSapien” & open the NeoSapien Plugin
Click on Install Plugin
Sign in with your NeoSapien account (may differ from your ChatGPT account)

caption: Open chat, enable NeoSapien & try your first prompt: “

caption.text: What do you know about me from Neosapien?

items.caption: Congrats NeoSapien is now connected to ChatGPT.

caption: Open

caption.text: chatgpt.com

caption: in your laptop browser

items.caption: Click your profile picture
Select Settings
Click the Connected apps tab
Click the Add button
Select Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Enter name: NeoSapien and URL: https://api.neosapien.xyz/mcp
Click Advanced settings if you need to add OAuth credentials
Check the box: I understand and want to continue. Click Create
Sign in with your NeoSapien account (may differ from ChatGPT account)

blocks.title: Already connected on claude.ai?
bullets: Connectors added from Claude’s directory are available across Claude, including Claude Code — the terminal setup below is only needed if you want to add it directly.

caption: Ensure Claude Code CLI is installed:

caption.text: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

caption: Open terminal, run Claude and then run this command:

caption.text: claude mcp add --transport http neosapien https://api.neosapien.xyz/mcp

caption: Inside Claude Code run

caption.text: /mcp

caption: → select neosapien → Authenticate - it opens a browser to sign in.
Sign in to NeoSapien when prompted (OAuth) & Run

caption.text: claude mcp list

caption: or

caption.text: claude mcp get neosapien

caption: in terminal to verify the status.
Open a new Claude Code chat & try your first prompt: “

caption.text: What do you know about me from Neosapien?

items.caption: Congrats NeoSapien is now connected to Claude Code.

items.question: What is NeoSapien MCP?
items.answer: MCP connects your AI assistant to your NeoSapien memories. Your AI can search, retrieve and reference everything you have recorded — without copy-pasting or switching apps.

items.question: Which AI tools are supported?
items.answer: Any AI tool that supports MCP, such as Claude or ChatGPT Pro. Tools without MCP support won't work.

items.question: Do I need to set it up every time?
items.answer: No. It's a one-time setup. Once connected, NeoSapien stays available in your AI tool.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Your memories are shared only with the AI tool you connect, over an authenticated (OAuth) sign-in. You can remove NeoSapien from your connectors at any time.

items.question: What if my AI says it cannot find memories?
items.answer: Add “from NeoSapien” to your message. If it still doesn't work, re-authenticate or remove and re-add NeoSapien from your connectors.

items.question: How do I get my API key?
items.answer: MCP uses OAuth sign-in, so there's no API key to paste — just sign in with your NeoSapien account when prompted.

items.question: Can I use the same account across multiple AI tools?
items.answer: Yes. Sign in with the same NeoSapien account in each tool to reach the same memories everywhere.

items.question: AI says it has no tools or cannot find MCP
items.answer: Restart your AI app after adding the NeoSapien MCP. The tool only loads on startup.

items.question: Hammer icon not showing in Claude Desktop
items.answer: Check claude_desktop_config.json for JSON formatting errors. Ensure the file is in the correct directory.

items.question: AI finds no memories
items.answer: Add 'from NeoSapien MCP' to your prompt. Without this trigger the AI may not query your memories. Restart the app if it persists.

items.question: MCP server timeout
items.answer: Check your internet connection. The server at api.neosapien.xyz/mcp must be reachable.

items.question: Config changes not taking effect
items.answer: Fully quit and relaunch the app not just reload.

blocks.title: Still having issues?
bullets: Reach out from the Neosapien app and we’ll help you get connected.
